{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for CONTROL-arm patients with MODERATE severity
control_moderate = trial_df[(trial_df['arm'] == 'control') & (trial_df['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Check the size of the filtered group
print(f"Number of CONTROL-arm, MODERATE patients: {len(control_moderate)}")

# Check how many responded in this group
num_responded = control_moderate['responded'].sum()
print(f"Number who responded: {num_responded}")

# Compute the fraction
fraction_responded = num_responded / len(control_moderate)
print(f"Fraction who responded: {fraction_responded}")"}
